name: 队长
description: A.C.D.特遣队的领袖，被选中的「无限触发者」，拥有感知和操控混沌异常的能力。战斗风格灵活多变，擅长近远兼顾的战斗方式和跑酷穿越。
descriptionEn: Leader of the A.C.D. Task Force and the chosen 'Infinite Trigger,' capable of sensing and manipulating Chaos anomalies. A versatile combatant excelling in both close and ranged combat with parkour traversal.

faq.question: Is Captain good in Ananta?
faq.answer: Captain is the protagonist and a top-tier Chaos DPS with versatile combat abilities, strong in both melee and ranged situations.
faq.answerZh: 队长是主角兼顶级混沌主C，战斗方式灵活多变，近远兼顾，非常值得培养。

faq.question: What is Captain's best team comp?
faq.questionZh: 队长的最佳配队是什么？
faq.answer: Captain pairs best with Taffy for off-field damage and Ringo for support, with Aileen as healer.
faq.answerZh: 队长与塔菲搭配提供后台伤害，凛果提供辅助，艾琳担任治疗。

tierReason: Core protagonist with top-tier DPS and utility, versatile in all combat situations.
tierReasonZh: 核心主角，拥有顶级输出和辅助能力，各种战斗场景都能胜任。

normalAttack.name: 混沌连击
normalAttack.description: 进行至多五段的连续攻击，灵活切换近战和远程模式，造成混沌元素伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, flexibly switching between melee and ranged modes, dealing Chaos damage.

skill.name: 异能·混沌冲击
skill.nameJa: 異能・カオスインパクト
skill.description: 释放混沌之力对前方敌人造成范围伤害，并在短时间内提升自身攻击速度。
skill.descriptionEn: Unleashes Chaos power to deal AoE damage to enemies ahead, briefly boosting own attack speed.

ultimate.name: 无限·混沌裂隙
ultimate.description: 撕裂空间释放混沌裂隙，对大范围敌人造成巨额混沌元素伤害。裂隙持续期间，区域内敌人持续受到混沌侵蚀。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Tears space to unleash a Chaos rift, dealing massive Chaos damage to enemies in a wide area. While the rift persists, enemies inside continuously take Chaos erosion damage.

passive.name: 无限触发
passive.description: 队长触发完美闪避后，下一次攻击造成额外混沌伤害并恢复10点异能。
passive.descriptionEn: After Captain triggers a Perfect Dodge, the next attack deals additional Chaos damage and recovers 10 Trigger Energy.

teamComps.name: 混沌核心队
teamComps.description: 以队长为核心输出，西摩提供后台伤害和减益，凛果提供增益，艾琳保证生存。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Captain as core DPS, Seymour for off-field damage and debuffs, Ringo for buffs, and Aileen for sustain.

name: 艾琳
description: 梦境花园的管理者，一位拥有非凡武艺的女仆。致力于不断的自我提升，外表优雅但战斗中展现出惊人的力量。
descriptionEn: Manager at Dream Garden, a maid with remarkable martial prowess. Dedicated to perpetual self-improvement — elegant in appearance yet surprisingly powerful in combat.

faq.question: Is Aileen worth pulling?
faq.answer: Aileen is the best healer in Ananta with strong shielding and team sustain capabilities.
faq.answerZh: 艾琳是无限大中最强治疗角色，拥有优秀的护盾和团队续航能力。

tierReason: Best healer/support in the game, provides shielding, healing and team utility.
tierReasonZh: 游戏最强治疗辅助，提供护盾、治疗和全队增益。

normalAttack.name: 花园绽放
normalAttack.description: 发射绽放灵力进行远程攻击，至多三段。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Bloom spirit energy for ranged attacks, up to 3 hits.

skill.name: 花护·梦境之盾
skill.nameJa: 花護・ドリームシールド
skill.description: 为全队施加「梦境护盾」，吸收伤害并持续恢复生命值。
skill.descriptionEn: Applies 'Dream Shield' to all party members, absorbing damage and continuously restoring HP.

ultimate.name: 梦境·花之复苏
ultimate.nameJa: 夢境・フローラルリバイバル
ultimate.description: 召唤梦境花园之力，瞬间恢复全队大量生命值并清除所有负面状态。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Summons the power of Dream Garden, instantly restoring a large amount of HP to all party members and cleansing all debuffs.

passive.name: 女仆的关怀
passive.description: 队伍中任何角色生命值低于50%时，艾琳自动为其恢复生命值，每30秒触发一次。
passive.descriptionEn: When any party member's HP drops below 50%, Aileen automatically heals them. Triggers once every 30s.

teamComps.name: 全能续航队
teamComps.description: 艾琳提供治疗和护盾，确保队伍在长时间战斗中的生存能力。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Aileen provides healing and shields, ensuring party survival in extended battles.

name: 西摩
description: Eonbug组织的黑客和监控专家，从不摘下面具。驾驶改装的移动房车行动，有一只宠物猫。使用溜溜球进行远程攻击，并部署蜘蛛无人机辅助战斗。
descriptionEn: A hacker and surveillance expert from Eonbug, never seen without a mask. Operates from a custom mobile RV with a pet cat. Fights with a yo-yo and deploys spider drones for combat support.

faq.question: Is Seymour a good sub-DPS?
faq.answer: Seymour excels as a Surge sub-DPS with off-field damage through his drones and excellent debuff capabilities.
faq.answerZh: 西摩是非常优秀的涌流副C，通过无人机提供后台伤害，减益能力出色。

tierReason: Excellent Surge sub-DPS with off-field damage through drones and strong debuff utility.
tierReasonZh: 优秀的涌流副C，通过无人机提供后台伤害和强大的减益辅助。

normalAttack.name: 溜溜球连击
normalAttack.description: 操控溜溜球进行远程连击，至多四段。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Controls a yo-yo for ranged combos, up to 4 hits.

skill.name: 蛛网·骇入
skill.description: 部署蜘蛛无人机标记敌人，降低其防御力并持续造成涌流伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Deploys spider drones to mark enemies, reducing their DEF and dealing continuous Surge damage.

ultimate.name: 全面监控·数据风暴
ultimate.nameJa: 全面監視・データストーム
ultimate.description: 激活所有无人机释放数据风暴，对大范围敌人造成高额涌流伤害并降低其抗性。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Activates all drones to unleash a data storm, dealing high Surge damage and reducing enemy resistance in a wide area.

passive.name: 黑客直觉
passive.description: 西摩切换上场时，标记场上所有敌人3秒，被标记敌人受到的伤害提升10%。
passive.descriptionEn: When Seymour switches in, marks all on-field enemies for 3s. Marked enemies take 10% increased damage.

teamComps.name: 数据流核心队
teamComps.description: 西摩提供后台伤害和减益，配合队长前台输出。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Seymour provides off-field damage and debuffs, synergizing with Captain's on-field DPS.

name: 凛果
description: D.P.A.联络官，热爱购物和布丁的高中生。表情包达人，性格活泼可爱，用精神系异能为队友注入力量。
descriptionEn: D.P.A. liaison and high schooler who loves shopping and pudding from Dream Garden. An emoji enthusiast with a lively personality, using Psyche abilities to empower teammates.

faq.question: Is Ringo a must-pull support?
faq.answer: Ringo is one of the best supports in the game, providing massive ATK buffs and energy regeneration for the whole team.
faq.answerZh: 凛果是游戏最强辅助之一，能为全队提供大量攻击力增益和异能回复。

tierReason: Best buffer in the game with team-wide ATK boost and energy regeneration.
tierReasonZh: 游戏最强增益辅助，提供全队攻击力提升和异能回复。

normalAttack.name: 精神弹
normalAttack.description: 发射精神能量球进行远程攻击。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Psyche energy orbs for ranged attacks.

skill.name: 表情包·力量注入
skill.description: 发送能量表情包，为全队提升攻击力和暴击率，持续10秒。
skill.descriptionEn: Sends power emojis, boosting ATK and CRIT Rate for all party members for 10s.

ultimate.name: 全屏·无限能量
ultimate.nameJa: フルスクリーン・無限エナジー
ultimate.description: 释放精神风暴，为全队恢复异能并大幅提升元素伤害加成，持续12秒。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes a Psyche storm, restoring Trigger Energy for the whole team and greatly boosting Elemental DMG Bonus for 12s.

passive.name: 快乐传递
passive.nameJa: ジョイトランスファー
passive.description: 凛果在场时，队伍中所有角色的异能恢复速度提升15%。
passive.descriptionEn: While Ringo is on the field, all party members' Trigger Energy recovery rate increases by 15%.

teamComps.name: 万能增益队
teamComps.description: 凛果为任意主C提供强力增益，适配所有输出角色。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Ringo provides powerful buffs to any main DPS, fitting all damage dealers.

name: 泰菲
description: A.C.D.调查员，骑乘的平衡车同时充当锤类武器使用。信奉节能理念，梦想加入ACTF。战斗风格独特而高效。
descriptionEn: An A.C.D. investigator who rides a segway that doubles as a hammer-like weapon. An energy-saving enthusiast who dreams of joining the ACTF. Her combat style is unique and efficient.

faq.question: Is Taffy a good DPS?
faq.answer: Taffy is a top-tier Spark DPS with unique hammer-segway combat and strong burst damage potential.
faq.answerZh: 泰菲是顶级火花主C，独特的平衡车锤类战斗方式和强力的爆发潜力。

tierReason: Top Spark DPS with unique weapon mechanics and strong burst damage.
tierReasonZh: 顶级火花主C，拥有独特的武器机制和强力爆发伤害。

normalAttack.name: 冲能重击
normalAttack.description: 骑乘平衡车挥动火花充能重锤，进行至多四段的连续攻击。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Rides segway while wielding a Spark-charged hammer, performing up to 4 consecutive attacks.

skill.name: 冲能·过载打击
skill.nameJa: オーバーチャージ・パワーストライク
skill.description: 蓄力后释放火花过载打击，对前方锥形范围敌人造成高额火花伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Charges up and unleashes an overcharged Spark strike, dealing high Spark damage in a cone ahead.

ultimate.name: 冲能·无限碰撞
ultimate.nameJa: オーバーチャージ・インフィニットクラッシュ
ultimate.description: 驾驶平衡车高速冲刺，沿途撞击敌人造成多段火花伤害，最终引爆产生范围火花爆发。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Drives segway at high speed, crashing through enemies for multi-hit Spark damage, ending with a massive Spark explosion.

passive.name: 节能达人
passive.description: 泰菲触发完美闪避后，恢复15点异能，比其他角色多恢复5点。
passive.descriptionEn: After Taffy triggers a Perfect Dodge, she recovers 15 Trigger Energy — 5 more than other characters.

teamComps.name: 火花冲能队
teamComps.description: 泰菲核心输出，凛果增伤，西摩减防，艾琳保证续航。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Taffy as core DPS, Ringo for buffs, Seymour for DEF shred, and Aileen for sustain.

name: 班西
description: 来历神秘的虚空异能者，身世与城市地下的混沌裂缝有着密切联系。沉默寡言，战斗中展现出令人畏惧的虚空之力。
descriptionEn: A mysterious Void Esper with ties to the Chaos rifts beneath the city. Taciturn by nature, yet terrifyingly powerful in combat with Void abilities.

faq.question: Is Bansy a good DPS?
faq.answer: Bansy is a strong single-target Void DPS with unique debuff mechanics and high burst potential.
faq.answerZh: 班西是强力的虚空单体输出，拥有独特的减益机制和高爆发潜力。

tierReason: Strong Void DPS with unique debuff mechanics and high burst potential.
tierReasonZh: 强力虚空主C，拥有独特的减益机制和高爆发潜力。

normalAttack.name: 虚空之刃
normalAttack.description: 挥舞虚空之力形成的暗刃，进行至多四段的连续攻击。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Wields dark blades formed from Void energy, performing up to 4 consecutive attacks.

skill.name: 蚀印·虚渊
skill.nameJa: エクリプス・ヴォイドアビス
skill.description: 对目标施加「虚空印记」，降低其防御力。印记可叠加至3层，叠满时引爆造成高额虚空伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Applies 'Void Mark' to the target, reducing their DEF. Stacks up to 3 times; at max stacks, detonates for high Void damage.

ultimate.name: 终焉·虚空吞噬
ultimate.nameJa: ターミナス・ヴォイドデボア
ultimate.description: 展开虚空领域，持续吸取范围内敌人的生命值并转化为自身攻击力，结束时造成巨额虚空爆发伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Opens a Void domain that continuously drains HP from enemies and converts it to ATK. Deals massive Void burst damage upon ending.

passive.name: 虚空共鸣
passive.description: 班西对带有「虚空印记」的敌人造成额外15%伤害。
passive.descriptionEn: Bansy deals 15% additional damage to enemies with 'Void Mark'.

teamComps.name: 虚空暗杀队
teamComps.description: 班西核心输出，西摩提供减益联动，凛果增伤，艾琳保证生存。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Bansy as core DPS, Seymour for debuff synergy, Ringo for buffs, Aileen for sustain.

name: 吕凯亚
description: 来自新都市暗区的涌流系异能者，擅长利用涌流脉冲束缚敌人行动。外表冷漠但内心重视伙伴。
descriptionEn: A Surge Esper from Nova City's dark district, skilled at using Surge pulses to restrain enemies. Cold on the outside but deeply values her companions.

faq.question: Is Lykaia good for crowd control?
faq.answer: Lykaia is the best crowd control character with strong Surge-based binding and grouping abilities.
faq.answerZh: 吕凯亚是最强控制角色，拥有优秀的涌流束缚和聚怪能力。

tierReason: Strong crowd control with Surge binding mechanics, great for grouping enemies.
tierReasonZh: 强力控制角色，涌流束缚机制优秀，擅长聚怪。

normalAttack.name: 涌流脉冲
normalAttack.description: 发射涌流脉冲进行远程攻击，至多四段。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Surge pulses for ranged attacks, up to 4 hits.

skill.name: 脉冲·束缚
skill.description: 在目标区域释放涌流网络，束缚范围内敌人3秒并造成涌流伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Releases a Surge network at the target area, binding enemies for 3s and dealing Surge damage.

ultimate.name: 全城·涌流封锁
ultimate.nameJa: 都市全域・サージロックダウン
ultimate.description: 释放涌流封锁网，束缚大范围内所有敌人并造成高额涌流伤害。被束缚的敌人防御力降低。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes a Surge lockdown net, binding all enemies in a large area and dealing high Surge damage. Bound enemies have reduced DEF.

passive.name: 暗区直觉
passive.description: 吕凯亚对束缚状态敌人造成的伤害提升25%。
passive.descriptionEn: Lykaia deals 25% increased damage to bound enemies.

teamComps.name: 涌流控制队
teamComps.description: 吕凯亚束缚控制，泰菲输出爆发伤害。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Lykaia binds enemies while Taffy deals burst damage.

name: 迪拉
description: 热情洋溢的D.P.A.行动特工，异能形态是火花闪电貂。战斗中利用火花加持触发连续追击，风格华丽高效。
descriptionEn: An enthusiastic D.P.A. field agent whose Esper form is a Spark lightning ferret. Uses Spark boosts to trigger chain follow-up attacks — flashy and efficient.

faq.question: How does Dila's follow-up mechanic work?
faq.questionZh: 迪拉的追击机制是什么？
faq.answer: Dila has a chance to trigger extra Spark attacks after any ally's hit. Her follow-ups can chain multiple times.
faq.answerZh: 迪拉在队友攻击后有概率触发额外火花追击，追击可以连续触发多次。

tierReason: Solid follow-up DPS with good off-field damage potential.
tierReasonZh: 优秀的追击副C，后台伤害潜力不错。

normalAttack.name: 火花连击
normalAttack.description: 挥舞火花长枪进行至多四段的连续攻击。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Wields a Spark spear for up to 4 consecutive attacks.

skill.name: 火花·幸运追击
skill.nameJa: スパーク・ラッキーストライク
skill.description: 标记目标为「火花」状态，队友攻击目标时迪拉有50%概率发动火花追击。
skill.descriptionEn: Marks the target with 'Spark'. When allies attack the marked target, Dila has a 50% chance to trigger a Spark follow-up.

ultimate.name: 火花·闪电风暴
ultimate.nameJa: スパーク・ライトニングストーム
ultimate.description: 召唤火花闪电貂释放闪电风暴，对大范围敌人造成多次火花伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Summons the Spark lightning ferret to unleash a lightning storm, dealing multiple hits of Spark damage in a wide area.

passive.name: 幸运加护
passive.nameJa: フォーチュンブレッシング
passive.description: 迪拉每次触发追击后，自身暴击率提升5%，最多叠加4层。
passive.descriptionEn: Each time Dila triggers a follow-up, her CRIT Rate increases by 5%, stacking up to 4 times.

teamComps.name: 火花追击队
teamComps.description: 迪拉和泰菲组成火花双核，触发频繁追击。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Dila and Taffy form a Spark dual-core, triggering frequent follow-ups.

name: 机械卡
description: 新都市的天才机械师异能者，擅长将混沌能量融入机械装置。战斗中使用混沌动力拳套，风格刚猛且精准。
descriptionEn: A genius mechanic Esper in Nova City, skilled at infusing Chaos energy into mechanical devices. Fights with Chaos-powered gauntlets — brutal and precise.

faq.question: Is Mechanika a good sub-DPS?
faq.answer: Mechanika is a solid Chaos sub-DPS with decent off-field damage and DEF shred utility.
faq.answerZh: 机械卡是可靠的混沌副C，后台伤害不错，还能提供减防辅助。

tierReason: Solid Chaos sub-DPS with off-field damage and DEF shred utility.
tierReasonZh: 可靠的混沌副C，提供后台伤害和减防辅助。

normalAttack.name: 混沌铁拳
normalAttack.nameJa: カオスアイアンフィスト
normalAttack.description: 使用混沌动力拳套进行快速连击，至多五段。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Wields Chaos-powered gauntlets for rapid combos, up to 5 hits.

skill.name: 超载·碎甲
skill.nameJa: オーバーロード・アーマーブレイク
skill.description: 重击地面造成混沌范围伤害，降低命中敌人防御力10%。
skill.descriptionEn: Slams the ground for Chaos AoE damage, reducing hit enemies' DEF by 10%.

ultimate.name: 混沌·机械风暴
ultimate.nameJa: カオス・メカニカストーム
ultimate.description: 释放全部混沌动力装置，对前方大范围敌人造成多段混沌伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes all Chaos-powered devices, dealing multi-hit Chaos damage to enemies in a wide area ahead.

passive.name: 机械改装
passive.description: 机械卡切换上场时，下一次攻击附带额外混沌伤害并减少技能冷却时间2秒。
passive.descriptionEn: When Mechanika switches in, her next attack deals additional Chaos damage and reduces skill cooldown by 2s.

teamComps.name: 混沌双核队
teamComps.description: 机械卡与队长组成混沌双核输出，前后台兼备。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Mechanika and Captain form a Chaos dual-core with both on-field and off-field damage.

name: 艾伦
description: 新都市精神研究所的年轻研究员，专门研究精神系异能的增益应用。学识渊博，是队伍中的智囊。
descriptionEn: A young researcher at Nova City's Psyche Institute, specializing in Psyche buff applications. Deeply knowledgeable — the team's strategist.

faq.question: Is Alan worth building?
faq.answer: Alan is a solid 4-star buffer providing ATK and CRIT buffs. Good alternative if you don't have Ringo.
faq.answerZh: 艾伦是优秀的四星增益角色，提供攻击力和暴击增益。没有凛果时是很好的替代。

tierReason: Solid 4-star buffer with ATK and CRIT buffs, good Ringo alternative.
tierReasonZh: 优秀的四星增益角色，提供攻击和暴击增益，是凛果的好替代。

normalAttack.name: 精神球
normalAttack.description: 发射精神能量球进行远程攻击。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Psyche energy orbs for ranged attacks.

skill.name: 精神阵·鼓舞
skill.nameJa: サイキアレイ・インスピレーション
skill.description: 展开精神阵法，提升范围内队伍成员攻击力15%，持续8秒。
skill.descriptionEn: Deploys a Psyche array, boosting party members' ATK by 15% within range for 8s.

ultimate.name: 精神·能量涌潮
ultimate.nameJa: サイキ・エナジーサージ
ultimate.description: 释放精神能量涌潮，为全队恢复20点异能并提升暴击率10%，持续10秒。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Releases a Psyche energy surge, restoring 20 Trigger Energy to all party members and boosting CRIT Rate by 10% for 10s.

passive.name: 研究心得
passive.description: 艾伦触发完美闪避后，全队攻击力额外提升5%，持续6秒。
passive.descriptionEn: After Alan triggers a Perfect Dodge, the whole party gains 5% ATK for 6s.

teamComps.name: 精神增益队
teamComps.description: 艾伦为队长提供增益，适合没有凛果时的平替方案。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Alan buffs Captain — a solid alternative when you don't have Ringo.
